			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.

				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.

				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.

				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.

				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.

				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)

				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.

				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).

				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)

				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning

				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan

				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)

				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.

				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.

			RPSC 1st Grade Teacher (School Lecturer/ Coach) 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
				
				
				Use BLUE or BLACK pen only to fill OMR sheets.
				
				
				If more than one circle is marked, 1/3 marks are deducted.
				
				
				Timely and correct filling of the OMR is essential.

			📝 Exam Structure (Common for Lecturer & Coach)

			
				
				Total Marks: 450

				
					
					Paper I: 150 Marks (1 hour 30 minutes)
					
					
					Paper II: 300 Marks (3 hours)
					
				
				
				
				Type of Questions: All Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				
				Negative Marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer or multiple answers.
				
			

			 

			✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks

			
				
				40% for each paper
				
				
				Relaxation of 5% for SC/ST candidates
				
			

			 

			📚 Scheme for the post of School Lecturer

			Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (focus on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Statistics (Secondary Level), Mathematics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi & English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
				
				Educational Psychology, Educational Management, Rajasthan Education Scenario, RTE Act, 2009
				
			

			 

			Paper II – Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 hours
			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Subject Knowledge (Senior Secondary Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Graduation Level)
				
				
				Subject Knowledge (Post-Graduation Level)
				
				
				Pedagogy, Teaching Learning Material, ICT in Teaching & Learning
				
			

			 

			🏆 Scheme for the post of Coach

			
				
				Same paper format as Lecturer.
				
				
				Additional 40 marks may be awarded for sports/tournament participation, based on criteria (see Note).
				
			

			 

			📘 Exam Pattern (Coach & Physical Education Lecturer)

			    📍 Total Marks: 460

			
				
				Paper I: 200 marks
				
				
				Paper II: 260 marks
				
				
				+40 marks can be awarded for sports/tournament participation (based on certificates and performance).
				
			

			 

			📝 Paper I – General Studies

			Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes
			Maximum Marks: 200
			Includes:

			
				
				History of Rajasthan & Indian History (with emphasis on Indian National Movement)
				
				
				Mental Ability, Maths (Secondary Level), Statistics (Secondary Level), Language Ability (Hindi, English)
				
				
				Current Affairs
				
				
				General Science, Indian Polity, Geography of Rajasthan
				
			

			 

			🏅 Paper II – Sports/Subject Concerned

			Duration: 3 Hours
			Maximum Marks: 260

			Subjects Covered:

			
				
				Knowledge of Physical Education & Sports
				
				
				Sports Sciences
				
				
				General Theory and Method of Training
				
				
				Special Knowledge of Games/Sports and current affairs
				
			

			 

			📊 Award of Marks for Sports Achievements (Max 40 Marks)

			
				International (winner/participant): 40 / 36 / 32 Marks
				National (I, II, III position): 28 / 24 / 22 Marks
				State Level (winner/participant): 20 / 16 
				District Level (I, II, III): 12 / 8 / 4
			

			🏆 Levels Defined:

			
				
				District Level: School/college tournaments under recognized departments.
				
				
				State Level: State tournaments under School/College Education Departments.
				
				
				National Level: Tournaments by School Games Federation of India, Navodaya Samiti, etc.
				
				
				International Level: Through SGFI, University Sports Board, Sports Associations.
				
			

			 

			✅ Verification of Sports Certificates

			
				
				Certificates must be verified by:

				
					
					Secretary of Rajasthan Sports Council
					
					
					Head of Institute with clear level of event
					
					
					Federation/association for international/national recognition.
					
				
				
			

			⚠️ Important Rules

			
				
				Negative marking: 1/3rd marks deducted for wrong or multiple answers.
				
				
				Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40% (5% relaxation for SC/ST).
